caption: The worked example's seven items on the four-layer stack: the four VMs, the load balancer and the 500 GB object store sit at the virtualisation layer, the 200 GB managed database at the platform layer, the portal at the application layer. Totals to check are 7 items, 16 vCPU, 32 GB RAM and 700 GB storage, and security, management and governance apply to every one of those items.

spec.aria: A four-layer stack, top first: application holding the student portal, platform holding the 200 GB managed database, virtualisation holding the four VMs with 16 vCPU and 32 GB in total plus the load balancer and the 500 GB object store, and physical holding the provider's servers, disks and switches, with consumer control at the top and provider control at the bottom.
